decisions.reason: The click-in DUOLARE adapter was featured prominently on the home page as a launch highlight. It is a low-cost accessory tied to the firm's track lighting system. Public commitment and its role in that system favour keeping it despite the lack of recent evidence.

This single LED luminaire got only a passing mention, so visible commitment is modest. LED luminaires are core to the firm's announced direction, which makes keeping it more likely than dropping it, though the case is weaker.

The home automation server box is peripheral to the firm's lighting core and was only mentioned. Its development investment and the hope that smart-home demand will grow make management likely to persist with it rather than write it off.

The luminaire family had a dedicated page, which signals substantial investment and public commitment. Any weak results can still be blamed on temporary causes such as pandemic-related market disruption, so management would continue it.
